title: Concept: Predictable generator via new Random() (java) — review required
description: In java, new Random() creates a general-purpose generator seeded from the clock. The sequence is deterministic once the seed or a few outputs are known, so passwords, session identifiers and one-time codes derived from it can be predicted. Draw security values from SecureRandom.
applicability: java code that mints tokens, codes or salts; lexical scope.
